The structure of Li8Mg4Sn4 (reduced formula Li2MgSn) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216), containing 16 atoms in the unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows Li centers with 12 neighbors (4 Li, 4 Mg, 4 Sn) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg and Sn each have 16 neighbors (8 Li, 4 Mg, 4 Sn). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Li 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Li and Mg or Sn 16-vertex polyhedra.
